# Guest-only independent preflight of the native framed tree peer.
import json, socket
from pathlib import Path
h=Path('/tmp/parity-home'); ready=json.loads((h/'native-peer-ready.json').read_text())
assert ready['address']=='127.0.0.1' and 1<=ready['port']<=65535
def read_exact(s,n):
    b=b''
    while len(b)<n:
        v=s.recv(n-len(b))
        if not v:raise RuntimeError('short response')
        b+=v
    return b
def exchange(cmd):
    with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',ready['port']),timeout=3) as s:
        c=cmd.encode(); s.sendall(b'BASHSSH1\ncmd-len %d\nstdin-len 0\n\n'%len(c)+c)
        head=b''
        while not head.endswith(b'\n\n'):
            head+=read_exact(s,1)
            if len(head)>512:raise RuntimeError('header limit')
        ls=head[:-2].decode('ascii').split('\n'); assert len(ls)==4 and ls[0]=='BASHSSH1-RESP'
        fields=dict(x.split(' ',1) for x in ls[1:]); assert fields['rc']=='0' and fields['stderr-len']=='0'
        return read_exact(s,int(fields['stdout-len']))
assert exchange('pwd')==b'/fixture\n'
assert exchange("cd '/fixture' && cd 'space dir' && pwd")==b'/fixture/space dir\n'
assert exchange("cd '/fixture/space dir' && ls -la")==b'selected-needle\n'
print('native-control=PASS')
files.native-ready-check.py:
# Guest-only ready-record integrity; no product invocation.
import json, os, stat, sys
from pathlib import Path
if len(sys.argv) != 2: raise SystemExit(125)
expected = int(sys.argv[1]); path = Path('/tmp/parity-home/native-peer-ready.json')
fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC)
try:
    st = os.fstat(fd)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_uid != 2000 or st.st_nlink != 1 or st.st_size > 512: raise ValueError('invalid ready file')
    raw = os.read(fd, 513)
finally: os.close(fd)
doc = json.loads(raw)
if (type(doc) is not dict or set(doc) != {'pid','address','port'} or type(doc['pid']) is not int or doc['pid'] != expected or doc['address'] != '127.0.0.1' or type(doc['port']) is not int or not 1 <= doc['port'] <= 65535): raise ValueError('invalid ready identity/address/port')
print(doc['port'])

ADAPTER_SOURCE=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-sftp-ssh-r3.py
ADAPTER_TARGET=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-sftp-adapter
/usr/bin/install -m 0755 "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET"
/usr/bin/sha256sum "$ADAPTER_TARGET" > "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
/usr/bin/stat -c "mode=%a uid=%u" "$ADAPTER_TARGET" >> "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
read -r adapter_sha adapter_name < "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
[[ $adapter_sha == 18b2920ad89a6f9a85bb595147ad9ea087c794d9b1956673783770c3d540df3b && -x "$ADAPTER_TARGET" ]] && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET" || { echo "CONTROL-FAILED adapter copy/hash/mode"; exit 98; }
H=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-sftp-adapter
FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT="$HOME/control-remote"
printf '%s\n' '{"phase":"control","deny":false}' > "$HOME/sftp-config.json"
mkdir -p "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" remote
printf 'control contents\n' > "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT/control-name"
printf 'pwd\nls\n' > "$HOME/control.batch"
[[ -x /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server && -x "$H" ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED missing executable'; exit 98; }
"$H" fixture pwd > "$HOME/control-command.out"
[[ $(/usr/bin/cat "$HOME/control-command.out") == "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED shell endpoint'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/sftp -b "$HOME/control.batch" -S "$H" fixture > "$HOME/control-sftp.out" 2> "$HOME/control-sftp.err"
/usr/bin/grep -Fq 'control-name' "$HOME/control-sftp.out" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED OpenSSH SFTP endpoint'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/grep -Fq "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" "$HOME/control-sftp.out" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED remote pwd'; exit 98; }
printf '%s\n' '{"phase":"case","deny":false}' > "$HOME/sftp-case-config.json"
/usr/bin/install -m 0600 "$HOME/sftp-case-config.json" "$HOME/sftp-config.json"
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/sftp-case-config.json" "$HOME/sftp-config.json" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED configuration copy'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/cp "$HOME/sftp-invocations.jsonl" "$HOME/control-invocations.jsonl"
: > "$HOME/sftp-invocations.jsonl"

/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/sftp-native-tree-peer-r1.py >"$HOME/native-control-peer.stdout" 2>"$HOME/native-control-peer.stderr" & ctrl=$!
trap 'if [[ -n $ctrl ]]; then kill "$ctrl" 2>/dev/null; wait "$ctrl" 2>/dev/null; fi' EXIT
for ((i=0;i<200;i++)); do [[ -s "$HOME/native-peer-ready.json" ]] && break; kill -0 "$ctrl" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
if [[ ! -s "$HOME/native-peer-ready.json" ]] || ! /usr/bin/python3 "$PWD/native-ready-check.py" "$ctrl" > "$HOME/native-control.out" 2> "$HOME/native-control.err" || ! kill -0 "$ctrl" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'CONTROL-INCOMPLETE native readiness' >&2; exit 125; fi
